correctness.rationale: After translating the centers, each coordinate contributes independently to two support counters. The stated local polynomial exhausts and uniquely classifies every overlap value by whether it is nonzero relative to each center. Multiplication and coefficient truncation therefore count every common output exactly once. A direct finite implementation agrees throughout an exhaustive grid; the computation is corroborative rather than foundational.

value.rationale: The exact pairwise intersection is the natural ambiguity quantity in sequence reconstruction. The theorem resolves it for every center pair and all parameters and yields a direct O(n t^2) evaluator, replacing only bounds at the instance level. It is structural and all-parameter rather than a routine finite computation.
